scope: Complete installation, termination, labeling and certification of one explicitly scoped structured-cabling system with 48 selected Cat6 information outlets JACK-RJ45-CAT6 and 2 selected 24-port patch panels PP-24-CAT6. Rack cabinets, active network equipment, CCTV, access control, fire alarm and electrical power distribution are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved telecommunications design organization, structured-cabling integrator, component manufacturer, certification authority and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved information-outlet layout and numbering schedule
approved copper cable, outlet, faceplate, patch-panel and patch-cord schedule
approved telecommunications routes and containment schedule
termination, labeling, grounding and firestopping details
installation method with labor, access and certification-equipment quantities
permanent-link certification program and test-report schedule
outlet-module supplier package size and approved retained spare quantity
forbiddenClaims: outlet, cable or containment quantities derived from floor area alone
static 432-m route or generic electrical productivity
automatic rack, active-network, fiber or uplink selection
universal spare quantity or supplier package
CCTV, access control, fire alarm or electrical distribution included
